local function DJWZ_fake_script() -- infyield.LocalScript 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', infyield)
 
    script.Parent.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source'),true))()
    end)
end
coroutine.wrap(DJWZ_fake_script)()
local function DWWDMJ_fake_script() -- nds.LocalScript

        loadstring(game:HttpGet"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pcallskeleton/RX/refs/heads/main/5.lua")()
    end)
end
coroutine.wrap(DWWDMJ_fake_script)()
local function LOGFSJJ_fake_script() -- bie.LocalScript 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', bie)
 
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local mainGui = playerGui:WaitForChild("Main")
    local exploitsForBABFT = mainGui:WaitForChild("BABFTexploits")
    local c = false
    
    script.Parent.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        if c == false then
            exploitsForBABFT.Visible = true
            c = true
        else
            exploitsForBABFT.Visible = false
            c = false
        end
    end)
    
end
coroutine.wrap(LOGFSJJ_fake_script)()
local function KMKYIPK_fake_script() -- Speed.LocalScript 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Speed)
 
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    
    local button = script.Parent
    
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 170
        end
    end)
    
    
end
coroutine.wrap(KMKYIPK_fake_script)()
local function QINHF_fake_script() -- SuperJump.LocalScript 
    local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', SuperJump)
 
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    
    local button = script.Parent
    
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
            task.wait(0.1)
            humanoid.JumpPower = 200
        end
    end)
    
    
end
coroutine.wrap(QINHF_fake_script)()
